page.overview:
Who is Abscissa?

When the real Jubilee and Roberto were pulled into the game for its public launch, Abscissa aided the two of them, helping them to advance through the levels as Mojo was furious at not being able to squish her.

Finally, Abscissa hacked Jubilee and Roberto out of the game server and into the broadcast server, where she revealed her face and history and explained them what was going on.

Mojo soon entered into the game himself, and Abscissa teamed up with Roberto and her younger self to defeat him, which freed the two of them from the game. The fate of Abscissa herself after the game was shut down remains unknown.
